what_this_is: The transaction checklist the Academy teaches, as data. It assembles a closing FILE — the documents to demand, the clauses to read, and the unknowns each contingency exists to resolve. It contains no clause language and drafts nothing: every state-sensitive item is written as a QUESTION FOR COUNSEL, never as a statement of what the law is.
what_this_is_not: Not a contract, not a form, not legal advice, and not a claim about any state's law. See docs/CONTRACT_ANATOMY.md for the line this platform will not cross, and docs/states/README.md for the record-layer facts that carry sources and dates.

clauses.does: Names who binds whom; an entity needs authority documents before it can sign.
clauses.ask_counsel: What does my entity have to produce in this state to prove authority to sign, and who has to sign it?

clauses.does: The legal description, not the mailing address.
clauses.ask_counsel: Which recorded description governs here — plat, metes-and-bounds, or the square/lot form used in Louisiana practice — and does the one in the contract match the recorder's?

clauses.does: Price, earnest money, who holds it, and when it becomes at-risk.
clauses.ask_counsel: Who may hold the deposit in this state, under what trust or escrow rules, and what makes it non-refundable?

clauses.does: The exit if the loan fails: amount, rate ceiling, deadline.
clauses.ask_counsel: How must notice be given to preserve this exit, and by when?

clauses.does: The exit for condition, with a defined window and delivery duties.
clauses.ask_counsel: What access am I entitled to, and what is local practice on re-inspection and repair negotiation?

clauses.does: What the seller must tell the buyer.
clauses.ask_counsel: Which disclosure forms are mandatory here, what hazard regimes apply (flood, natural hazard, point-of-sale ordinances), and what does this state's caveat-emptor posture put back on me?

clauses.does: Marketable title, exceptions, the title commitment, survey objections.
clauses.ask_counsel: Is this an attorney state or a title-company state, what survey standard is expected, and which exceptions in the commitment should I refuse?

clauses.does: Where, when, who conducts it, and when keys change hands.
clauses.ask_counsel: Who closes in this state — attorney, escrow or title — and which deed form is customary?

clauses.does: Splitting taxes, rents and deposits at closing.
clauses.ask_counsel: Does the assessment reset on sale here, and am I prorating against the seller's bill or against mine?

clauses.does: What happens if either side walks: liquidated damages, specific performance.
clauses.ask_counsel: Which of these remedies is actually enforceable in this state, and what does the foreclosure regime imply if I am the one who fails?

clauses.does: Whether the buyer can assign the contract.
clauses.ask_counsel: Is assignment restricted or licensed in this state, and does what I am planning need a licence?

clauses.does: Estoppels, rent-roll delivery, deposit transfer, lease assumption.
clauses.ask_counsel: What does state and city landlord-tenant law require on deposits and on assuming leases, and is there rent regulation in this municipality?

documents.label: Recorded deed / chain of title
documents.why: Establishes what the record says the seller owns.

documents.label: Assessor parcel record and use class
documents.why: The platform's own basis for every value figure; re-pull it yourself.

documents.label: Current tax bill and any delinquency
documents.why: The seller's bill is often not your bill — recompute at your basis.

documents.label: Permit history and open code cases
documents.why: Unpermitted work is a title and insurance problem, not a decorating one.

documents.label: Zoning verification for the intended use
documents.why: Zoning is local everywhere; the recorded use class is not permission.

documents.label: Certificate of occupancy / legal unit count
documents.why: A unit that is not legal is not income; it is a liability with a tenant in it.

documents.label: Current rent roll
documents.why: Rents are never public record. The roll you inherit is not the one you underwrote.

documents.label: Every lease, in full
documents.why: The document where the money actually lives.

documents.label: Signed estoppel certificates
documents.why: The tenant's own statement of the deal, which is the one that binds you.

documents.label: Security-deposit ledger and transfer
documents.why: Deposits are the tenants' money; you assume the obligation at closing.

documents.label: T-12 operating statements
documents.why: Measured history, not hope. Compare line by line against your own expense stack.

documents.label: STR / PMS report — ADR, occupancy, RevPAR by month
documents.why: Lodging income is a daily business; an annual average hides the season that pays for the year.

documents.label: Franchise agreement, PIP and transfer terms
documents.why: The brand's required improvement plan is a capital call that arrives with the keys.

documents.label: Pad-lease form, utility metering and park rules
documents.why: In a pad-rent business the homes and the dirt can have different owners.

documents.label: Enrolment and university housing policy for the ring
documents.why: Demand here is a policy decision made by an institution, not a market.

documents.label: Preliminary title report / commitment
documents.why: Liens, easements and exceptions — read the exceptions, not the cover.

documents.label: Survey, to the standard local practice expects
documents.why: Where the boundary actually is, versus where the fence is.

documents.label: HOA budget, reserves, litigation and rental caps
documents.why: A rental cap can make an income thesis illegal on day one.

documents.label: Inspection: structure, roof, drainage, sewer lateral, electrical panel
documents.why: The condition unknowns the inspection window exists to resolve.

documents.label: Environmental and hazard screen for this parcel
documents.why: Flood, subsidence, wildfire and contamination are parcel facts with published layers.

documents.label: Three rent comps from a property manager who leases here
documents.why: The platform's rent basis is index-derived; a manager's comps are the check on it.

documents.label: Insurance quote in writing
documents.why: The app carries an estimate. An estimate is not a quote and never becomes one by being typed into a quote field.

documents.label: Lender term sheet or pre-approval matching this structure
documents.why: An offer, not a record. It expires, and the deadline in the contract runs against it.

documents.label: Entity formation, good standing and authority to sign
documents.why: The contract binds whoever had capacity to sign it.

contingencies.label: Inspection / due-diligence window
contingencies.note: The window exists to convert condition and operating unknowns into answers before they become losses.

contingencies.label: Financing contingency
contingencies.note: The exit for the term-sheet unknown. It resolves an offer, not a fact about the world.

contingencies.label: Title review period
contingencies.note: The exit for record unknowns — liens, easements, description mismatches.

closing_rule: A buyer who signs with unknowns unresolved has converted "unknown" into "assumed" — the exact laundering this platform refuses in its worksheets (docs/INTEROP.md).
